gates.requirement: Every input is explicitly typed, root-confined, symlink-rejected, and byte-bounded.
Malformed and oversized inputs preserve the external source and create a failed receipt without source or artifact occurrence records.
Audio decode, resampling, and normalization create immutable derivative artifacts with lineage and a receipt.
Every ObservationRecord cites its AcquisitionEvent and portable external authority digest, with explicit units and availability.
ApparatusSpec declares possible surfaces; ApertureSpec derives only evidenced run/input ranges and permitted-operation intersections.
SPL and extra-human-frequency claims remain unavailable without the corresponding calibration evidence.
Imported text remains dataOnly and cannot execute through ingress.
Successful state changes atomically persist domain records, a durable receipt, lineage edges, and one ordered event.
